findings.title: 章节导航重复扣除滚动容器偏移
findings.trigger: 点击阅读卡片“精简/验证”或滚动切换当前章节
findings.impact: 章节跳转位置提前约132px，当前章节高亮提前切换
findings.evidence: root Chrome: article.offsetTop=132, section.offsetTop=223, clicked scrollTop=91; 标题距可视区域顶部132.49px。section.offsetTop已相对position:relative article。
findings.fix: 滚动及current判定使用section.offsetTop，同一坐标系并处理最后一节。

findings.title: 滑动删除接受右键和不匹配的pointerup
findings.trigger: 右键按下并左拖超过100px；或pointer1拖动后pointer2抬起
findings.impact: 非主操作/其他手指能够调用不可逆业务onAction
findings.evidence: 独立JSDOM /tmp/forge-audit-actions-swipe.mjs: RIGHT_DRAG_DELETE_COUNT 1; UNRELATED_POINTER_UP_DELETE_COUNT 2。原型071明确拒绝e.button!==0。

findings.title: 键盘删除邮件后焦点掉回body
findings.trigger: Tab聚焦任一删除按钮并按Enter/Space
findings.impact: 按钮随行卸载，键盘用户失去列表位置；撤销也未恢复该行焦点
findings.evidence: /tmp/forge-audit-actions-flows.log: 071_AFTER_DELETE_ACTIVE_ELEMENT BODY；原型071会聚焦下一行及撤销后的首行。
findings.fix: 删除前记录邻项/按钮ref，删除后移至下项、上项或空态/撤销；undo聚焦恢复行。

findings.title: 倾斜卡片光斑写死蓝色
findings.trigger: 050切换紫色或黑色并悬停卡片
findings.impact: 主体主题已切换，光斑仍为blue，不符合主题一致性
findings.evidence: forge-surface-card[data-effect="tilt"]:before radial-gradient直接使用--color-fg-blue；SurfaceCard无color/token override，case只设置--fusion-accent。静态确定，浏览器截图未采集。
findings.fix: 使用可覆盖的主题CSS变量并让case传当前主题。

ListItem without onSwipeAction returns original content unchanged
ProgressBar linear rendering retains legacy colors/sizes and adds finite-value clamp; ring/indeterminate additive
Stepper without items retains original total/current dots; items branch additive
SurfaceCard previous class/slots preserved; new use-client and section attrs inspected
Tooltip portal migration is broad; viewport/dialog cleanup inspected; browser regression scope remains root-owned
Toast new update/status/actions preserve id; old toast/dismiss signatures unchanged; timer reset order inspected

observations.detail: Localized recommendation names are state keys: direct props rerender zh→en loses pressed state; official wrapper key=id-locale remounts whole case, so not presented as unique official runtime defect.
